---
title: "Examples"
---

This section contains examples of what the built-in styles look like
when rendered as a website. This is meant to demonstrate how the content would be structured, not what the entire website would like in detail. Colors, font, etc can be customized through the website generator's theming capabilities; [the Quarto theming documentation](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html) can be referred to as an example.

- [Style: Quarto one page](quarto-one-page/index.qmd)
